## Scope

- [ ] Documentation/navigation only; `r13-r26-cavity/` is unchanged.
- [ ] Scientific change to protected JFM material.

For a scientific change, follow `JFM_R13_R26_PROTECTION.md` and provide the
baseline commit, equation or numerical contract, reproduction command,
before/after evidence, and updated hashes.  General cleanup must leave the
protected tree byte-for-byte unchanged.
